messages.subject: coercing unmarkedFitColExt
parts:
Hello All,

Not sure if this is an unmarked question or just a R question, but I figure this group could answer both.

I want to write a colext results to a csv. I can identify the information with this:  models@fits[ms@Full$delta=='0']

I tried using as() to coerce it to a data.frame, but to no avail. A closer look shows that the output class is unmarkedFitColExt.

showMethods(coerce) doesn't present any available coercion methods. How can I make this output "writable" 

Thank you
Kyle

messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: RE:[unmarked] coercing unmarkedFitColExt
parts:
Hi Kyle,

if you want to save the entire results (the entire object), you can use save(your.object, file = "your.filename"). To import the results back into R during a later session, just use load(file = "your.filename"). Otherwise, if you really want a data.frame, you will have to extract only the portion of the results of interest to you and convert them to a data.frame.

Best,

Marc

messages.author: 527d9b3ec7deff2d
messages.subject: Re: coercing unmarkedFitColExt
parts:
Alternatively, assuming that "ms" is a modSel object, you can write this object (or subsets of it) to csv directly:

write.csv(ms@Full,file="ms.csv")
write.csv(ms@Full[ms@Full$delta==0,],file="ms_d0.csv")

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: coercing unmarkedFitColExt
parts:
There are some other options shown at the bottom of the help page for modSel():

coef(ms)                            # Estimates only
SE(ms)                              # Standard errors only
(toExport <- as(ms, "data.frame"))  # Everything
